mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 150k signals stronger labor demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1.2 million units signals weakening residential investment, which reduces capital expenditures and drags on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST remains below 1.2 million for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 1.0% growth signals weaker manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO growth is below 1.0% for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month increase in CPI above 3.0% signals higher inflation, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPI rises above 3.0% in one month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE remains below 3.5% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures below $690 billion signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS falls below $690 billion for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month increase in FEDFUNDS above 5.5% signals a tightening cycle, which raises borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5% in one month (t-test p > 0.05).
